title: Gene annotation from the Saccharomyces Genome Database (R64-4-1)
measurement: reference gene annotation, not a measurement

provenance.validation: the GFF is R64-4-1 while sacCer3 is built on R64-1-1; those differ in annotation and not in sequence, and the pipeline verifies it rather than assuming it - all 17 chromosome features match sacCer3.chrom.sizes exactly, and the run aborts otherwise. Only chrmt is renamed, to chrM.
provenance.caveat: UCSC serves its own SGD Genes track on sacCer3, built from a different release by a different pipeline; these tracks exist for the embedded JBrowse panel, which has no native annotation, and are not added to the hub overview for that reason
